case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer and for setting out your cost drivers so clearly. We value our long cooperation and want to renew the agreement on a sound basis. Our own data shows a different picture:

Our orders of Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 with you were placed at EUR 414.61 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011548-10), EUR 400.19 on 2025-06-30 (po:4500012634-10), EUR 412.74 on 2026-01-27 (po:4500013491-10) and EUR 412.74 on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014465-10): the price has not risen.

Your on-time delivery was 84.6% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70530@2026Q3).

Against this background we have prepared three structured options. The longer contract term and the binding volume give you planning certainty, and the payment terms vary so you can choose what suits you best. Each option is laid out so it can go straight to your pricing committee, and we are glad to provide any further information it needs.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 401.34; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 389.61; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 398.68; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have verified your records regarding past purchase orders and our delivery performance; nevertheless, our current cost structure requires a baseline adjustment. As to the delivery record and price history data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.

We are prepared to accept your proposed 24-month contract term to support your planning certainty. Our current Angebot is a price of €430.31 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

In exchange for this extended commitment and maintaining the 30 days net payment terms, we can offer a revised price of EUR 428.85 per unit, specifically a price of €428.85 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 404.96; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 393.12; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 402.28; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.

Each option stands on its own, and Option B and Option C answer your wish for different payment terms. If your approval needs anything further from us, please tell us and we will provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
